audit.why: 53.6% over 1485 games at FAV / 4/10 is consistent. Level chart (Vayne, Vayne, Galio, Vayne, Skill, Vayne, Vayne) already matches the mirror's corrected chart, and win[] and phases[].side agree row for row, so no chart edits are proposed.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is: Vayne, Vayne, Galio, Vayne, Skill, Vayne, Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phases describe cooldown-based windows without any cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s; Condemn is 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s; Final Hour is 100/85/70s. Concrete numbers make 'engage when it is down' actionable.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch down 9s at rank 3 is the commit window; Hero's Entrance is a 180s roam, not a duel button.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Condemn denies the Justice Punch dash, Shield of Durand only reaches 275, and Condemn only stuns into terrain.
audit.why: Galio's sole gap-closer is a dash; Condemn's knockback removes him from it. His taunt is a 275-range release, so kiting outside that range removes his lockdown entirely. Condemn's stun requires terrain collision — on open ground it is a reposition.
audit.corrected: Hold Condemn for Justice Punch, stay outside 275 to deny Shield of Durand, and remember Condemn only stuns into a wall.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'In Final Hour' as a probable wrong ability name. It is a false positive — Final Hour is Vayne's real R name per the kit file.

edits.before: In Final Hour you Condemn his E Justice Punch engage, kite the W taunt range, and shred his resist-stacked body with true damage he can't itemize against.
edits.after: In Final Hour, Condemn his Justice Punch (E) engage on its 7s cooldown, stay outside the 275-range Shield of Durand taunt, and shred his resists with true damage.

edits.before: His kill threat is the E Justice Punch into W taunt combo, but the E is short and easily Condemned or Tumbled; whiff it and he has no way to stop your true-damage trades.
edits.after: His kill threat is Justice Punch (E, 650) into the 275-range Shield of Durand taunt; Condemn it out and with E down 9s he cannot stop your true-damage trades.

edits.before: R Hero's Entrance is a roam, not a duel win against you.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a 180s roam tool, not a duel win.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch is his only gap-closer, down 9s at rank 3 — Condemn it or step out, then commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Inside 275 range Shield of Durand taunts you into his full combo.

edits.before: Tumbling INTO his engage or fighting in melee — every death starts with a greedy tumble forward.
edits.after: Without terrain behind him it is a 20s knockback, not a stun — save it to deny his Justice Punch.
